name: Sample bedroom office
description: A small bedroom that doubles as an office, at night. A desk with a laptop sits in the top-right corner, hidden from the window by a tall bookshelf. A bed with the only lamp is on the left, a closet on the right, and doors lead to the hallway and the bathroom. You climbed in through the window.

facts.text: The bed has storage drawers underneath, so there is no space to hide under it.
A tall bookshelf stands between the window and the desk, so neither can be seen from the other.
The closet is deep enough for one person to stand inside.
The bedside lamp is the only light in the room at night.

objects.name: laptop
objects.notes: A silver laptop on the desk. This is what you came for.

objects.name: coffee mug
objects.notes: A ceramic mug. It would shatter loudly.

objects.name: pillow
objects.notes: A soft pillow. It barely makes a sound when it lands.

objects.name: bedside lamp
objects.notes: The only light in the room. Without it the room is dark.

objects.name: bed
objects.notes: A double bed. It looks like there may be space underneath.

objects.name: closet
objects.notes: A tall closet with a door.

objects.name: curtains
objects.notes: Long curtains that reach the floor.

objects.name: bookshelf
objects.notes: A tall bookshelf that blocks the view between the window and the desk.
